senses.gloss: (cmp. בִּין, בָּקַר a. oth.) to examine carefully, to be particular, exact in expression; to pay special attention, to mind. Ib. 6ᵃ, a. fr. דָּק ואשכח he examined and found.
units: Succ. 8ᵃ לא דק he did not express himself exactly; a. fr.—Part. דָּיֵיק careful.
<cite ref="Ketubot 18b:7">Keth. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>מֵידַק ד׳</he> he is very careful (as to what witnesses he uses).
<cite ref="Yoma 83b">Yoma 83ᵇ</cite> <he>הווה ד׳ בשמא</he> minded a man’s name (considering it an indication of his character).
<cite ref="Yoma 83b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>לא הוו דַיְיקֵי בשמא</he> did not mind &c.
Ib. דַּיְיקִיתוּ ye mind.—Part. Peil דָּיִיק (v. Pa.) proved, conclusive.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 3b">B. Kam. 3ᵇ</cite> those verses <he>לא כמר דָּיְיקֵי וכ׳</he> are no evidence either for the one or the other.—Denom. <cite ref="D00696"><he>דֵּיקָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="D00533"><he>דְּיוּקָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="D00326"><he>דּוְקָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 155a">Sabb. 155ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>דדֵיְּיקָה ואכלה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דדיקה באוכלא</he>) she grinds her food carefully.

senses.gloss: to argue by pressing a word, to analyze, prove.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 31b">Keth. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ מרישא</he> takes his argument from the first clause; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 27:18">Targ. Y. Lev. XXVII, 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 25:50">Ib. XXV, 50</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00989"><he>דִּקְדֵק</he></cite>; a. e.
Koh. R. to III, 9 א׳ מלכא the king was irritated. Pesik. B’shall. p. 86ᵇ; Yalk. Sam. 152 אוֹדִיקַת סרח וכ׳ Serah … grew angry; cmp. דִּקְדֵּק.—2) to examine, look with anxiety, wait attentively.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 7:6">Targ. Prov. VII, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 14:2">Targ. Ps. XIV, 2</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>אודיק</he> … <he>לקלהון</he> R. … examined into the noise they made; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 665">Yalk. Lev. 665</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 352">Yalk. Is. 352</cite>. Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ top; Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ top <he>א׳ לון תכ׳</he> Bar K. looked out for them (waiting for them to ask him).
